data.current_description:
Create a new audience segment.

**`DYNAMIC` segments** (the default) are defined by a `condition` — a boolean tree that is re-evaluated against your contacts, so membership changes on its own as contact data changes. `condition` is required for these.

**`STATIC` segments** hold a manually managed member list; `condition` is ignored. Add members with `POST /segments/{id}/members`.
data.summary_suggestion: Create a new audience segment with dynamic or static membership
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new audience segment for organizing and targeting contacts. Supports two segment types: DYNAMIC segments (default) use a condition filter that automatically updates membership as contact data changes—condition is required for this type. STATIC segments maintain a manually managed member list and ignore conditions—add members separately using POST /segments/{id}/members. Returns the created segment object with a 201 status code.
